def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Normalize sex label variants (FEMALE -> female); missing stays NaN (unknown)
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip().str.lower()
    # Fix negative flipper lengths (sign errors)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].abs()
    # Body mass must be within [2500, 6500] grams; invalidate out-of-range values
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].where(df['body_mass_g'].between(2500, 6500))
    return df
